title: feat: Replace hardcoded cell formatters with @object-ui/fields widgets in object-agrid
body:
## ✅ Implementation Complete: Integrate packages/fields into object-agrid

### Objective
Improve object-agrid to use field widget components from packages/fields for rendering cells in both read-only and edit modes.

### ✅ All Changes Completed

- [x] Add @object-ui/fields dependency to plugin-aggrid package.json
- [x] Create field-renderers.tsx with cell renderer and editor utilities
- [x] Implement custom AG Grid cell renderer that uses field widgets in read-only mode
- [x] Implement custom AG Grid cell editor that uses field widgets in edit mode
- [x] Update ObjectAgGridImpl.tsx to use the new cell renderers/editors
- [x] Clean up unused imports and variables
- [x] Address initial code review feedback
  - [x] Use explicit `Root` type from react-dom/client instead of `any`
  - [x] Use `unknown` type for currentValue instead of `any`
  - [x] Replace HTML string renderers with DOM element creation for security
- [x] **NEW: Address PR review feedback**
  - [x] Move widgetMap to module level for better performance
  - [x] Fix refresh() to update textContent for fallback case and return true
  - [x] Remove redundant lookup/master_detail cases from fallback switch
  - [x] Add comprehensive test coverage (17 new tests)
- [x] Build the package successfully (no errors)
- [x] All tests passing (29/29 tests, including 17 new field-renderer tests)
- [x] Type checking passes
- [x] CodeQL security scan passes (0 vulnerabilities)
- [x] Final validation complete

### Technical Implementation

**Added Files:**
- `packages/plugin-aggrid/src/field-renderers.tsx` (221 lines)
  - `widgetMap`: Module-level constant mapping 21 field types to widgets (performance optimization)
  - `getFieldWidget()`: Returns widget component for a given field type
  - `FieldWidgetCellRenderer`: AG Grid cell renderer using field widgets in readonly mode
  - `FieldWidgetCellEditor`: AG Grid cell editor using field widgets for editing
  - Factory functions for creating renderers/editors with field metadata
  - **Type-safe**: Uses `Root` type from react-dom/client
  
- `packages/plugin-aggrid/src/field-renderers.test.tsx` (328 lines)
  - **17 comprehensive tests** covering:
    - Widget mapping and fallback behavior
    - Renderer lifecycle (init, refresh, destroy)
    - Editor lifecycle and value handling
    - Memory cleanup (root.unmount())
    - Popup editor configuration
    - Factory function behavior

**Modified Files:**
- `packages/plugin-aggrid/package.json`: Added `@object-ui/fields` workspace dependency
- `packages/plugin-aggrid/src/ObjectAgGridImpl.tsx`: 
  - Imported field renderer utilities
  - Replaced 160+ lines of hardcoded formatters with field widgets
  - Removed redundant lookup case (already handled by field widgets)
  - Only master_detail remains in fallback for specialized handling
  - **Security**: Fallback renderers use DOM element creation instead of HTML strings

### Field Types Supported
✅ **21 field types** with full read-only and edit mode support:
- **Text fields**: text, textarea, email, phone, url, password, code
- **Numeric fields**: number, currency, percent, slider  
- **Date/Time fields**: date, datetime, time
- **Selection fields**: boolean, select, lookup
- **Visual fields**: color, rating, image, avatar

### Code Quality Metrics
✅ **Type Safety**: Explicit types, no `any` in new code
✅ **Security**: CodeQL scan passed (0 vulnerabilities)
✅ **Testing**: **29/29 tests passing** (including 17 new tests for field-renderers)
✅ **Test Coverage**: Comprehensive coverage of renderer/editor lifecycle, fallback, and edge cases
✅ **Build**: Clean build with no errors
✅ **Performance**: Module-level widgetMap prevents object recreation on every call
✅ **Maintainability**: -105 lines of code (replaced hardcoded logic with reusable components)

### Performance Improvements
✅ widgetMap defined at module level (avoids recreation on every getFieldWidget call)
✅ Improved refresh() logic returns true to avoid unnecessary DOM manipulation

### Test Coverage Summary
**New test file: `field-renderers.test.tsx`**
- FieldWidgetCellRenderer: 10 tests
  - Initialization (supported & unsupported types)
  - Null value handling
  - GUI element access
  - Refresh behavior (widget & fallback modes)
  - Memory cleanup on destroy
- FieldWidgetCellEditor: 5 tests
  - Initialization (widget & fallback modes)
  - Value handling
  - Popup configuration
  - Memory cleanup
- Factory functions: 2 tests
  - createFieldCellRenderer
  - createFieldCellEditor

### Benefits Achieved
✅ **Consistency**: All field types now render using the same widgets across forms, grids, and other components
✅ **Maintainability**: Centralized field rendering logic in `@object-ui/fields` package
✅ **Extensibility**: Easy to add new field types - just update the widget map
✅ **Security**: DOM-based rendering prevents XSS vulnerabilities
✅ **Performance**: Optimized widget lookup with module-level constant
✅ **Quality**: Comprehensive test coverage ensures reliability
✅ **DX**: Type-safe implementation with IntelliSense support
✅ **Edit Support**: Automatic edit mode for all 21 supported field types
